source.note: Built from the owner's catalogue sheets (October 2026) and mapping.json. The sheets say these are proposed personas and roles, not an export of real PlaceMakers logins.

systems.name: SAP Commerce
systems.note: commercetools stands in for SAP Commerce in this demo (real trial project, B2B structure loaded).

systems.name: ACE
systems.note: the ERP: prices on account, balances, deliveries. Sample data only until the real details arrive.

systems.name: GA4
systems.note: needs a GA4 property and a Google service-account key.

systems.name: Power BI
systems.note: needs a Power BI workspace the owner controls.

systems.name: Trade Portal
systems.note: counted as PlaceMakers' own site: the chat sits beside it.

systems.name: account permissions
systems.note: the B2B associate roles in commercetools (account-admin, buyer, site-manager, accounts-payable).

systems.name: SAP Commerce Cloud
systems.note: commercetools stands in for SAP Commerce in this demo.

teams.name: Customer Service
teams.note: Cases, orders, accounts and stock; raises a case after asking.

teams.name: Sales Managers
teams.note: Everything sales sees plus the pipeline and reports.

teams.name: Branch
teams.note: Counter staff and branch managers: stock by branch, orders, accounts, cases (read only).

teams.name: Finance
teams.note: Credit control: orders, account terms and cases (read only). Balances wait for the ERP.

teams.name: Insights
teams.note: Web traffic and reports; no customer records.

teams.name: Operations
teams.note: Pickers, yard, dispatch, drivers: needs the ERP, delivery planning and tracking.

teams.name: Estimating
teams.note: Estimators and planners: needs the Estimations system.

teams.name: Product Data
teams.note: Product information and merchandising: needs the product-information system (Salsify) and Bloomreach live.

teams.name: Digital Product
teams.note: Digital commerce product owner: needs Jira and GA4.

teams.name: IT and Integration
teams.note: CRM admin, integration and support engineers: needs MuleSoft, ACE logs and Jira.

personas.name: DIY Retail Shopper
personas.description: Individual buying building and home-improvement products without a trade account.
personas.goal: Find the right product at an accessible price and local store.

personas.name: Renovating Homeowner
personas.description: Homeowner planning a new bathroom, kitchen or renovation, often needing guidance.
personas.goal: Choose compatible products and obtain design advice.

personas.name: Trade Cash Sole Trader
personas.description: Independent builder using Trade Cash, purchasing at point of sale and online through the home branch.
personas.goal: Order competitively without maintaining a credit account.

personas.name: Trade Charge Business Owner
personas.description: Trade business principal owning a charge account with invoicing, branch access and team permissions.
personas.goal: Control spending and purchasing across jobs and staff.

personas.name: Head Contractor / Construction Firm
personas.description: Main contractor running multiple residential or commercial projects and project job accounts.
personas.goal: Coordinate bulk purchases, budgets and site deliveries.
personas.channel: Trade Portal; Trade App; account manager

personas.name: Construction Project Manager
personas.description: Builder-side manager accountable for project materials, variations and delivery schedules.
personas.goal: Keep projects on schedule without site shortages.

personas.name: Site Foreman / Supervisor
personas.description: Lead on site responsible for daily supply readiness and urgent materials.
personas.goal: Resolve immediate stock gaps and know delivery times.

personas.name: Apprentice / Delegated Team Buyer
personas.description: Team member authorized by a trade account owner to purchase limited items.
personas.goal: Place small orders without unrestricted account access.

personas.name: Construction Procurement Buyer
personas.description: Purchasing professional coordinating material orders across several jobs or branches.
personas.goal: Obtain availability, negotiated prices and reliable delivery.

personas.name: Builder Quantity Surveyor / Estimator
personas.description: Builder-side professional pricing materials and preparing customer quotations.
personas.goal: Prepare accurate cost estimates and compare costs by stage.

personas.name: Trade Accounts Administrator / Bookkeeper
personas.description: Office person managing invoices, balances, payments and job cost coding for a trade business.
personas.goal: Reconcile purchases and control liabilities.

personas.name: Plumbing Contractor
personas.description: Professional sourcing pipes, drains, fittings, tapware and bathroom materials.
personas.goal: Buy compatible supplies quickly with trade pricing.

personas.name: Electrician / Electrical Contractor
personas.description: Electrician buying building-site electrical supplies, tools and fittings.
personas.goal: Locate correct technical specifications and stock.

personas.name: Landscaping / Outdoor Contractor
personas.description: Tradesperson supplying decks, fencing, retaining walls and outdoor spaces.
personas.goal: Determine quantities and arrange bulky deliveries.

personas.name: Kitchen / Bathroom Installer
personas.description: Installer coordinating with homeowners, builders and PlaceMakers design consultants.
personas.goal: Get the right cabinets, fixtures and accessories before install.

personas.name: Architect / Product Specifier
personas.description: Professional comparing product dimensions, specifications and suitability for plans.
personas.goal: Recommend compliant product options to construction clients.
personas.roleBasis: Reasonable adjacent persona; not confirmed portal role

personas.name: Buying Group Member
personas.description: Purchaser accessing the separate GroupGate sign-in advertised on the PlaceMakers site.
personas.goal: Reach buying-group-specific shopping functions.
personas.roleBasis: Confirmed login segment; role workflows unverified

personas.name: Supplier / Manufacturer Portal User
personas.description: Supplier checking remittance, rebates, transaction and payment records.
personas.goal: Resolve payment questions without manual AP enquiries.

personas.name: Third-party Carrier / 3PL Partner
personas.description: Outside transport operator completing assigned site deliveries when subcontracted.
personas.goal: Receive delivery instructions, meet delivery windows and report exceptions.
personas.roleBasis: Evidenced partner in historical model; current contract scope unverified

personas.name: Trade Account Manager
personas.description: Field sales relationship owner supporting trade accounts, project needs, quotes and customer growth.
personas.goal: Retain customers and proactively support their jobs.

personas.name: Trade Support Advisor / Telesales
personas.description: Frontline adviser responding to trade phone, email, portal order messages and purchase queries.
personas.goal: Resolve requests without forcing customers to repeat details.

personas.name: Trade Support Team Leader
personas.description: Supervisor managing support queues, staff coverage, escalations and service consistency.
personas.goal: Keep service timely and prevent lost enquiries.

personas.name: Branch Counter Sales Associate
personas.description: In-branch staff helping walk-in customers select products, check stock and complete collection.
personas.goal: Serve trade and DIY customers quickly.

personas.name: Branch Manager / Operator
personas.description: Local store leader accountable for sales, inventory, team productivity and customer issues.
personas.goal: Balance customer service, branch revenue and stock.

personas.name: Estimations Specialist / Coordinator
personas.description: In-branch or national estimator translating building plans into project estimates.
personas.goal: Provide timely accurate stage-by-stage materials estimates.

personas.name: Frame and Truss Planner
personas.description: Specialist coordinating frame-and-truss design, manufacture and supply timelines.
personas.goal: Align technical components and manufacturing capacity with delivery dates.

personas.name: Kitchen and Bathroom Design Consultant
personas.description: Showroom specialist helping builders and end clients choose kitchen or bathroom products.
personas.goal: Turn design needs into orders and coordinated delivery.

personas.name: Warehouse Picker / Fulfilment Associate
personas.description: Warehouse employee assembling order lines for counter pickup or site delivery.
personas.goal: Ship correct items and prevent shortages.

personas.name: Yard Manager / Inventory Controller
personas.description: Person responsible for yard stock accuracy, loading and physical material availability.
personas.goal: Maintain reliable inventory and safe material movement.
personas.roleBasis: Confirmed yard function and device app opportunity

personas.name: Delivery Planner / Dispatcher
personas.description: Planner building routes, assigning delivery slots and resolving exceptions.
personas.goal: Deliver high-volume bulky materials at promised times.

personas.name: Company Fleet Driver
personas.description: PlaceMakers truck driver transporting building supplies to customer sites.
personas.goal: Follow route safely and confirm delivery outcomes.

personas.name: General Customer Service / Returns Agent
personas.description: Agent handling consumer enquiries, item defects, returns, and unresolved orders.
personas.goal: Resolve customer problems with complete case history.
personas.roleBasis: Confirmed Service Cloud function; role split inferred

personas.name: Credit Controller / Accounts Receivable
personas.description: Finance user responsible for trade balances, invoices, limits and overdue accounts.
personas.goal: Reduce credit risk and improve collection accuracy.

personas.name: Accounts Payable / Supplier Payments Officer
personas.description: Finance clerk reconciling supplier payments, remittances and rebates.
personas.goal: Pay correctly and respond to supplier queries.

personas.name: Product Information / PIM Specialist
personas.description: Catalog steward maintaining item names, technical specifications, attributes and images.
personas.goal: Keep descriptions and filters consistent across channels.

personas.name: Category / Pricing / Merchandising Manager
personas.description: Commercial owner of category assortment, discounts, branch pricing and product prominence.
personas.goal: Improve revenue without sacrificing availability.

personas.name: Marketing & Loyalty Manager
personas.description: Manager creating trade-targeted offers, loyalty rewards and mobile engagement.
personas.goal: Increase repeat purchases and campaign performance.
personas.roleBasis: Explicit deployed product and documented program

personas.name: Digital Analytics / SEO Specialist
personas.description: Analyst managing web and app measurement, search performance and conversion dashboards.
personas.goal: Trust journey data and detect drop-offs or broken tracking.
personas.channel: GA4; GTM; Google Search Console; Power BI

personas.name: Digital Commerce Product Owner
personas.description: Accountable for customer journeys, portal roadmap, mobile experience and release scope.
personas.goal: Prioritise the most valuable commerce improvements.

personas.name: Salesforce CRM / Case Administrator
personas.description: Platform admin responsible for CRM roles, support queues, rules and customer-data quality.
personas.goal: Keep Salesforce secure, consistent and reliable.

personas.name: Integration / ACE ERP Specialist
personas.description: Technologist maintaining MuleSoft, SAP Commerce API and ACE ERP transaction consistency.
personas.goal: Keep orders, prices and inventory synchronized across systems.

personas.name: Enterprise IT / Support Engineer
personas.description: FletcherTech or delivery support staff resolving enterprise service incidents, access issues and platform defects.
personas.goal: Restore services quickly with documented incident ownership.
personas.channel: IT service platform; Jira; support tools
personas.roleBasis: FletcherTech group role; PlaceMakers scope unverified

personas.name: Regional Trade Sales / Operations Manager
personas.description: Leader responsible for trade account growth and branch commercial performance.
personas.goal: Identify sales risks and improve account retention.

useCases.title: Find in-stock materials
useCases.story: As a diy retail shopper, I want to choose my store and check stock before checkout, so that I avoid a wasted store visit.

useCases.title: Order for home project
useCases.story: As a diy retail shopper, I want to buy common DIY supplies for collection or delivery, so that I can complete a small project quickly.

useCases.title: Plan a bathroom or kitchen
useCases.story: As a renovating homeowner, I want to get advice about layout and product choices, so that my renovation meets budget and space needs.

useCases.title: Get a consolidated quote
useCases.story: As a renovating homeowner, I want to review fixture, cabinet and accessory options together, so that I understand total material costs.
useCases.scope: Illustrative scenario; validate workflow and permissions

useCases.title: Order from home branch
useCases.story: As a trade cash sole trader, I want to buy materials online using my Trade Cash terms, so that I can keep a small job moving.

useCases.title: Order from a build estimate
useCases.story: As a trade cash sole trader, I want to select products for the next stage from my estimate, so that I reduce manual re-entry.
useCases.workflow: Jobs > BUILD IT estimate > stage > order

useCases.title: Delegate purchase permissions
useCases.story: As a trade charge business owner, I want to add staff and set what they can order or see, so that I maintain control over account spending.

useCases.title: Review credit and invoices
useCases.story: As a trade charge business owner, I want to see balances, statements and invoices for my business, so that I can manage cash flow.

useCases.title: Track multiple construction jobs
useCases.story: As a head contractor / construction firm, I want to see orders grouped by job account, so that I can control each project independently.

useCases.title: Stage site deliveries
useCases.story: As a head contractor / construction firm, I want to order different material groups for each construction stage, so that crews receive the right materials at the right time.

useCases.title: Create phased material plan
useCases.story: As a construction project manager, I want to turn suggested delivery items into draft orders, so that the site receives materials when needed.

useCases.title: Change an order
useCases.story: As a construction project manager, I want to request delivery date or order item changes, so that my project plan stays accurate.
useCases.workflow: Active order > message or edit request > support
useCases.scope: Illustrative scenario; validate workflow and permissions

useCases.title: Get urgent consumables

useCases.title: Check delivery status

useCases.title: Order within a spending limit

useCases.title: Choose supply branch

useCases.title: Download statements

useCases.title: Verify job charges
